title: The /join account check asks for one address instead of walking every auth user

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: joinEmailHasAccount (SCAN-906) answers an anonymous yes/no by paging admin.auth.admin.listUsers 1,000 at a time, up to 50 pages per call, so each check costs up to 50 admin API reads and grows with the user count, and a throttle that is open when Upstash is unconfigured leaves that cost unbounded. SCAN-1007 added the per-mailbox throttle. Fix: one indexed lookup, for example a SECURITY DEFINER auth_email_exists(text) granted only to service_role. Needs a migration.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('app/join/(induction)/actions.ts','utf8');const i=s.indexOf('export async function joinEmailHasAccount');const b=i<0?'':s.slice(i,i+2000);if(/listUsers\\(/.test(b)){console.error('SCAN-1013: the /join account check walks the auth user table page by page');process.exit(1)}"
